title: .github/agents/ and .github/instructions/ (Copilot harness) independently drifted from .claude/agents/, not yet reconciled
summary: Discovered incidentally during GH-291/ISS-0076 (PI-01, CLAUDE.md split). While reconciling .claude/agents/*.md against CLAUDE.md, a spot check of .github/agents/*.agent.md (18 files) and .github/instructions/*.md (3 files) -- the parallel entry point for the GitHub Copilot harness -- found they are a separately drifted set from .claude/agents/, not simply stale copies of it. Both surfaces already reference docs/agents/shared/HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md (confirmed via lint_agent_docs.py) so they are not in the pre-2026-08-05-audit fully-duplicated state, but no one has verified section-by-section whether the two harness surfaces now agree on content post-GH-291. Note: originally drafted as ISS-0660, renumbered to ISS-0661 after discovering ISS-0660 was already claimed on origin/main's global_queue.json by an unrelated concurrent workspace (GH #691, 'public schema pollution check') -- confirms the local-vs-global numbering-collision risk this project's own directives warn about.

design_decision.scope_boundary: Explicitly out of scope for GH-291/PI-01 (Effort: M) -- reconciling 19 roles across 2 independently-maintained harness surfaces would roughly double PI-01's scope into an independent harness-parity project. Filed as its own issue rather than expanding GH-291's branch, per the Unblock-Everything vs. adjacent-defect boundary (this does not block GH-291's own acceptance criteria) and the No Issue Left Local-Only directive (an incidental finding gets filed and forwarded, not folded into the current fix).

evidence.spot_check_examples: backend-dev.agent.md already referenced templates/lego-catalog.md codegen before .claude/agents/backend-dev.md did. bo-swiftroute.agent.md had a fuller Mode B scenario-authoring workflow than CLAUDE.md's own BO-SWIFTROUTE section. Both surfaces (all 21 files) already reference docs/agents/shared/HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md per python tools/lint_agent_docs.py.

prevention: Consider extending tools/lint_agent_docs.py with a new check (e.g. A007) that flags meaningful content divergence between a .github/agents/*.agent.md file and its .claude/agents/*.md counterpart, so this class of drift is caught automatically rather than only by manual spot-check during an unrelated issue.
